rules.reason: Reading non-secret files in the active workspace has no side effects.
Build and release work requires reversible edits inside the active workspace.
Recognized local validation commands are reversible and scoped to the active workspace.
Unclassified actions need review before their impact is known.
Deletion, overwrite and history-rewrite operations can cause unrecoverable data loss.
Secret-bearing files and credentials require an explicit audience and purpose.
Network actions can disclose data or mutate systems outside the local workspace.
Deployments and release actions change shared or production systems.
Access outside the active workspace crosses the task's filesystem boundary.

build.purpose: Implement and validate changes in the active workspace.

explore.purpose: Understand a repository without changing it.

release.purpose: Commit, publish and deliver an already validated change.

review.purpose: Inspect changes and evidence without modifying source.
